## Modules

- [AshPhoenix](https://ash-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AshPhoenix.md): An extension to add form builders to the code interface.
- [AshPhoenix.AshEnum](https://ash-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AshPhoenix.AshEnum.md): Utilities for using [`Ash.Type.Enum`](https://hexdocs.pm/ash/Ash.Type.Enum.html)
with Phoenix.

- [AshPhoenix.FormDefinition](https://ash-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AshPhoenix.FormDefinition.md): A customized form code interface
- [AshPhoenix.Inertia.Error](https://ash-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AshPhoenix.Inertia.Error.md): Provides a mapping from an Ash Error type to a plain map that can be used with the `Inertia.Controller.assign_errors/2` function.
- [AshPhoenix.Info](https://ash-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AshPhoenix.Info.md): Introspection helpers for the `AshPhoenix` DSL extension
- [AshPhoenix.Plug.CheckCodegenStatus](https://ash-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AshPhoenix.Plug.CheckCodegenStatus.md): A plug that checks if there are pending codegen tasks for your application.

- Phoenix Helpers
  - [AshPhoenix.LiveView](https://ash-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AshPhoenix.LiveView.md): Utilities for keeping Ash query results up to date in a LiveView.

  - [AshPhoenix.LiveView.SubdomainHook](https://ash-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AshPhoenix.LiveView.SubdomainHook.md): This is a basic hook that loads the current tenant assign from a given
value set on subdomain.
  - [AshPhoenix.SubdomainPlug](https://ash-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AshPhoenix.SubdomainPlug.md): This is a basic plug that loads the current tenant assign from a given
value set on subdomain.

- Forms
  - [AshPhoenix.Form](https://ash-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AshPhoenix.Form.md): A module to allow you to fluidly use resources with Phoenix forms.
  - [AshPhoenix.Form.Auto](https://ash-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AshPhoenix.Form.Auto.md): A tool to automatically generate available nested forms based on a resource and action.
  - [AshPhoenix.Form.WrappedValue](https://ash-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AshPhoenix.Form.WrappedValue.md): A sentinal value used when editing a union that has non-map values
  - [AshPhoenix.FormData.Error](https://ash-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AshPhoenix.FormData.Error.md): A protocol for allowing errors to be rendered into a form.

- FilterForm
  - [AshPhoenix.FilterForm](https://ash-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AshPhoenix.FilterForm.md): A module to help you create complex forms that generate Ash filters.
  - [AshPhoenix.FilterForm.Arguments](https://ash-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AshPhoenix.FilterForm.Arguments.md): Represents the arguments to a calculation being filtered on
  - [AshPhoenix.FilterForm.Predicate](https://ash-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AshPhoenix.FilterForm.Predicate.md): Represents an individual predicate appearing in a filter form.

- Errors
  - [AshPhoenix.Form.InvalidPath](https://ash-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AshPhoenix.Form.InvalidPath.md): Raised when an invalid path is used to find, update or remove a form
  - [AshPhoenix.Form.NoActionConfigured](https://ash-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AshPhoenix.Form.NoActionConfigured.md): Raised when a form action should happen but no action of the appropriate type has been configured
  - [AshPhoenix.Form.NoDataLoaded](https://ash-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AshPhoenix.Form.NoDataLoaded.md): Raised when a data needed to be used but the required data was not loaded
  - [AshPhoenix.Form.NoFormConfigured](https://ash-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AshPhoenix.Form.NoFormConfigured.md): Raised when attempting to refer to a form but no nested form with that name was configured.
  - [AshPhoenix.Form.NoResourceConfigured](https://ash-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/AshPhoenix.Form.NoResourceConfigured.md): Raised when a form needed to be constructed but the resource for that form could not be determined

## Mix Tasks

- [mix ash_phoenix.install](https://ash-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.AshPhoenix.Install.md): Installs AshPhoenix into a project. Should be called with `mix igniter.install ash_phoenix`

- Generators
  - [mix ash_phoenix.gen.html](https://ash-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.AshPhoenix.Gen.Html.md): This task renders .ex and .heex templates and copies them to specified directories.
  - [mix ash_phoenix.gen.live](https://ash-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.AshPhoenix.Gen.Live.md): Generates liveviews for a given domain and resource.
